definition.scope: All twelve fixed 128-token suite prompts, excluding incident64. After TTFT, all 127 intervals per prompt; not the 99-interval submission metric.
definition.S_ms: Rank0 speculative HALF(p+1) command completed minus received; includes snapshot.
definition.B_ms: Rank1 target HALF(p) command completed minus received; includes full target head; draft is separately reported.
definition.B_including_draft_ms: Paired B_ms + D_wall_ms. Serial work budget including draft; approximate because draft is asynchronous, not an exact GPU-time partition.
definition.D_wall_ms: Recorded draft publication wall time, not GPU kernel time.
definition.A_ms: Rank0 corrected non-speculative HALF(p) after miss.
definition.decision: Skip 22/26 when rank1 B >= S; tested even without charging the separate draft work.
